coverageNote: Kinwise reference set 2026.10.2: 427 medicines (766 brand names, 124 combination products), 89 AGS Beers 2023 rules (Table 2: 32, Table 3: 15, Table 4: 4, Table 5 and combinations: 14, Table 6: 24), 100 medicines scored on the ACB scale, 15 fall-risk classes, 26 prescribing cascades and 5 what-to-watch-for rules. Compiled from published criteria and cross-checked by automated research and an adversarial fact-check; not reviewed by a licensed clinician. It does not check doses, allergies or every interaction, and a medicine that is not flagged is not thereby shown to be free of risk.
acbHighNote: ACB totals of 3 or more are the published review threshold (elevated); Kinwise labels totals of 5 or more as 'high' for display only.
